book.name: Macho
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Macho gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Juda shɛɛŋ
Akfuuŋ gɛ̀ doo a yuude a too, bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba sage woŋ, bo shii bo chu ntaŋ kune Jiso ki bo yuuyɛ wu.
Bo mo bo kaaŋ wu, bo jo wu bo gɛɛŋ bo nya chiaaŋ yi Balɛt le wù gɛ̀ bee muh wù sage kimbe kiyu le.

Juda wù gɛ̀ gesɛ Jiso gɛ̀ doo wu yɛŋ lɛ ba le ba suunɛ wa lɛ ba le ba yuuyɛ wu, shɛ́ŋ tu yi sage wu yi fiɛɛ fì wu ge le wu mo wu jo bige bi mbaanshɛ biɛɛ wu kaasɛ wu gɛɛŋ bɛ bi ki wu chvûu bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba sage woŋ le.
Lɛ wu gɛɛŋ, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ, “Nle ŋge kimbefɛ ki ŋgesɛ muh wù kɛme gɛ jialɛ gɛ.” Bo chvuu wu le lɛ, “Fifiɛɛ kɛme la ki fi gê bɛ bee? Kee wo fiɛɛ fiyu.”
Juda bwaŋ bige biyu fɛkuu yeh yi kintanyɛ le, wu mo wu bu, wu gɛɛŋ wu shɛɛŋ.
Bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ tajɛ bige biyu bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Binɛ le bige bi kilɛmɛ, nchi baaŋ bɛɛŋ gɛ lɛ ba gɛɛ binɛ a nchvu wu yeh yi kintanyɛ le gɛ.”
Bo shii bo chu ntaŋ, bo gɛɛŋ bo gu gwɛŋ wu muh wù maa sháaŋ ki bo jiiyi bantolo fo.
Le fiɛɛ fì ba tɛŋe gwɛŋ wuyu bude abɛŋ lɛ, “Gwɛŋ wu Kilɛmɛ.”

Fi gɛ̀ kooshɛ noo lɛ fiɛɛ fì muh wu ntuŋ wu Tada Nyo wù Yɛlimia gɛ̀ jɛmɛ mo fi to fi kojɛ no wu gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ, “Bo gɛ̀ jo bige bi mbaanshɛ bì gɛ̀ bee ŋgesɛ we no booŋ ba Ishwala gɛ̀ kamɛ kikwɛɛ ke le,
bo gu gwɛŋ wu muh wù maa shíaaŋ le yu, gɛh no Tada Nyo gɛ̀ jɛme mɛne.”
Jiso lɛɛŋ a Balɛt fwe muh wù sage bala wu Lum
No Jiso gɛ̀ lɛme a Balɛt muh wù sage fwe, Balɛt biih wu le lɛ “Le wo wu le Nfoŋ wu Bajuu?” Jiso chvuu lɛ,
Geenɛ, bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba sage woŋ gɛ̀ doo bo kɛ bo chuunyi mwɛɛ yi wu le, wu gɛ ka wu chvuu lo fiɛɛ gɛ.
Balɛt mo wu biih wu le lɛ, “Gɛ wo yuge kfuu chi mwɛɛ munɛ mù ba chuunyi wo le gɛ?”
Geenɛ, Jiso gɛ chvuu lo fiɛɛ wu le mo fimimia fi bo kooyi wu le gɛ. Muh wù sage wuyu bijɛ nɛɛ jwe yuŋ wu baaŋ.
To nyume kife ki Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe, muh wù sage wunɛ bvusɛ muh wu mumwaa yeh yi ncha le, nyu wu wù bamii goone lɛ wu bvusɛ.
Gɛ̀ bee kife kiyu le, muh mu gɛ̀ bee yeh yi ncha le, ba gɛ̀ kee lo wu yi gee che chì befe le, jee che nyu lɛ Balaba.
Bamii gɛ̀ doo bo taashɛ, Balɛt biih bo le lɛ, “Bɛŋ goone lɛ mbvusɛ nyu yɛɛŋ yeh yi ncha le? Bɛŋ goone lɛ mbvusɛ Balaba noo, Jiso wù ba tɛŋe lɛ le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka la?”
Wu gɛ̀ biide noo nje wu gɛ̀ kee lo lɛ ba gɛ̀ nya Jiso chiaaŋ ye le, nyu nje bo gɛ̀ bɛɛne kindoŋ bɛ wu.

Fì taade fo le sege wu gɛ̀ shilɛ fɛ ba gɛ̀ sage bansa fo, kwɛɛ tuŋ ntuŋ fɛ wu le wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Keefɛ wo gê fiɛɛ bɛ muh wɛɛ gɛ. Le muh wù chaaŋ. Njɛme nɛ nje kifilɛ le ki njiiŋsɛ bɛ mɛ kintaŋ ki abɛŋ le baaŋ kune wu.”
No Balɛt biide noo, bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba sage woŋ bɛɛse bamii lɛ bo du lɛ wu bvusɛ nyu Balaba, ba lɛɛshɛ lo Jiso.
Muh wù sage ka wu ja wu biih bo le lɛ, “Muh wù bɛŋ goone lɛ nchinɛ antɛnɛɛ a bamii ba bafɛɛ banɛ le, le wù la?” Bo chvuu lɛ, “Balaba!”
Balɛt ka wu biih bo le lɛ, “Nɛ ndoo nchinɛ noo, ŋge nɛɛ bɛ Jiso wù ba tɛŋe lɛ Kletu?” Bo bachii jɛmɛ lɛ, “Ba ta lo wu yi kintaaŋ le.”
Wu ka wu biih lɛ, “Ba ta wu nje la? Fiɛɛ fì befe fì wu ge le la?” Bo ka bo wanɛ bo gɛɛne gɛh lo fwe fwe lɛ, “Ba ta lo wu yi kintaaŋ le.”

Balɛt gɛ̀ doo wu yɛŋ lɛ gɛ je nyu yu gɛ, lɛ wu luume bɛ fiɛɛ finɛ, jwe ja wu bu. Wu fi joo, wu chugɛ chiaaŋ ye yu a kinchvu ki bamii fwe wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Gɛ chiaaŋ yaŋ nyu fɛ kwe yi muh wunɛ le gɛ. Kee bɛŋ bɛ fi.”
Bamii bachii chvuu wu le lɛ, “Ɛɛŋ, chinɛ kilɛmɛ ke nyûme yi bikwɛɛ biɛsa le mo yi booŋ besa le.”
Balɛt mo wu bvusɛ Balaba no bo gɛ̀ goone, wu jɛmɛ ba taaŋ Jiso, bo mo bo nya lɛ ba gɛɛŋ ba ta yi kintaaŋ le.
Bamii ba nchi tu bo chwɛɛse Jiso
Bamii ba nchi ba muh wù sage wɛɛ mo bo jo Jiso bo lee bɛ wu a nto we le fɛ ba gɛ̀ tɛŋe lɛ Bletoliuŋ, bo mo bo kuŋ kimbɛge ki ŋgoo yi bamii ba nchi bachii bo taashɛ bo tuŋkigaŋ bo kɛnɛ Jiso.
Bo baayɛ njú ye, bo jo njú yi bvunfoŋ yì yɛɛde lo bo susɛ ye ye le,
bo lu kifo ki bvunfoŋ ki nyu mbiaŋmbiaŋ bo booŋ a wu fwa, bo nya kimbaŋ a kibo ke kinchiɛɛŋ le, lɛ le kitoomi. Bo mo bo too bo ŋgvuume a wù fwe bo chwɛɛse wu bo duu lɛ, “Biaa bimbaaŋ! Nfoŋ Bajuu!”
No bo gee noo, bo chuuyi chwɛne ye ye le, bo fii kimbaŋ bo shɛde wu yu a fwa.
Bo chwɛɛsɛ bo mɛsɛ, bo baa nju yi bvunfoŋ yɛɛ, bo kaasɛ bo jii wa nyu njú ye ye ye le, bo mo bo jo wu bo gɛɛne bɛ wu ki bo gɛɛŋ bo ta yi kintaaŋ le.
Ba ta Jiso yi kintaaŋ le
No bo gɛ̀ gɛɛne, bo bu yi muh mu wu a kilaantɛŋ kì Sɛliŋ le jee che nyu lɛ Samoŋ. Bo tooŋsɛ muh wɛɛ wu tuu kintaaŋ ki Jiso.
Bo gɛɛŋ bo bu kijusɛ kimu ki ba tɛŋe lɛ Golgota, jee chi kijusɛ kinɛ nyu lɛ Ŋgboge wu Kikwɛɛ,
bo mo bo nya mbvuuŋ ma ba fiiŋsɛ bɛ fiɛɛ fimi fì luji njɛ lele lɛ Jiso mu. Geenɛ wu doo wu moŋ, wu faŋ ki wu mû.
Bo mo bo ta wu yi kintaaŋ le, bo jo njú ye bo tuŋ kaŋ yu ki bo ga bikwɛɛ biboo le.
No bo ge noo bo mo bo shii fo bo tu bo chiɛɛne wu.
Bo saŋ ŋwa wù duunyi fiɛɛ fì bo ta wu yi kintaaŋ le nje fi, bo mo bo ta yi kintaaŋ le a kikwɛɛ ke we lɛ, “Wunɛ le Jiso, Nfoŋ Bajuu.”
Bo ta tɛ bachoŋ bafɛɛ yi bintaaŋ le bɛ Jiso, wumu a kibo kinchiɛɛŋ ki Jiso le, wumu a kiŋkoŋo le.
Bamii tu bo fede bo yɛde Jiso le bo bɛme bɛ bikwɛɛ, bo baade wu bɛ banchuŋ,
bo duu lɛ, “Wo wù chi bee ki wo sâ yeh yi kintanyɛ wo kaasɛ wo jooŋ yi aju le atade, gɛh fi la kikwɛɛ kuŋ! Nɛ wo fɛnɛ le Mwa Nyo, wo shii la yi kintaaŋ kɛɛ le.”
Bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba duunyi banchi mo bamii ba sage woŋ tu bo chwɛɛse tɛ wu bo duu lɛ,
“Wu chi fii bamii bamu njɛ taŋlo wu fi kikwɛɛ ke sɛŋ. Gɛ wu nyu Nfoŋ wu bamii ba Ishwala gɛ? Wu shii la yi kintaaŋ le mɛɛse bee mo be bɛɛŋ wu le.
Wu chi gɛɛde kikwɛɛ yi Nyo le. Nɛ Nyo fɛnɛ koŋe wu, wu fi la wu mɛɛse no wu chi duu lɛ wu le Mwa Nyo.”
Bachoŋ baa tɛ ba bo gɛ̀ ta yi bintaaŋ le bɛ Jiso, bo tu bo baade tɛ wu bɛ banchuŋ gɛh noo.
Jiso kwe
Juu gɛ̀ bɛɛŋ chi leesɛ, akfuuŋ ja ajiiŋ woŋ wuchii gɛɛne bude juu bikaa bitɛde fɛnshɛ.
Lɛ nyu njɛ juu bikaa bitɛde, Jiso ja wu jaŋ fɛwɛɛwe lɛ,
” Fì le lɛ,

content.text: “Nyo waŋ, Nyo waŋ, wo noŋ mɛ nɛ nje la?”

content: Bamii bamu ba gɛ̀ lɛme fo doo bo yu, bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Muh wuyu tɛŋe Alaja.”
Muh mu bo le mo wu legɛ lo kimimia wu jo kfusha, wu fuuŋ a mbvuuŋ ma ŋgbwamɛ le, wu booŋ yi finte le wu chiaasɛ lɛ wu mu.
Geenɛ bamii bamu jɛmɛ lɛ “Gɛh lɛɛŋ nɛ, besabɛŋ yɛŋ laa Alaja le wu to wu fi wu la.”
Jiso ka wu waŋ fɛwɛɛwe, wu mo wu nya kiyo ke Nyo le.
Fi ja fi kooshɛ lɛ, nju yì gɛ̀ gade yeh yi kintanyɛ antɛŋ gɛ̀ badɛ antɛnɛɛ kɛge fɛwe boge bude fɛkuu bimbe bifɛɛ. Nshɛŋ shiŋshɛ, ata baajɛ,
jɛ́ŋ tɛ gwenyɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ bee ba Nyo ba duude ba gɛ̀ kweeyɛ wa mo bo kaasɛ bo bu yi kwe le.
Jiso gɛ̀ doo wu bu yi kwe le, bamii bayu ja bo gɛɛŋ a kilaantɛŋ kì yuude le Yɛlusalɛm, bamii wesee yɛŋ bo le.

Chiji kikwɛɛ ki bamii ba nchi bɛ bamii ba bɛ bo gɛ̀ bee fo bo chiɛɛne Jiso, gɛ̀ doo bo yɛŋ no nshɛŋ shiŋshɛ, bɛ fiɛɛ fì kooshi le, nfaaŋ koo bo baaŋ. Bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Yi nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ le, muh wunɛ chi bee Mwa Nyo.”
Bikɛse ba duude gɛ̀ lɛme tɛ fo je yì ndefe le bo jiiŋe. Bikɛse banɛ le ba gɛ̀ ja Galalee bo bii Jiso le bo fii wu.
Ŋgoo yiboo gɛ̀ bee Mɛɛle Madaleŋ mo Mɛɛle wù bwe Jɛm bɛ Yosɛf, mo bwe booŋ ba Jɛbɛdi.
Ba jiiyɛ Jiso
Lɛ nyu fɛnfu, muh wu kwa wumu wu Alimatia ja wu to, jee che nyu lɛ Yosɛf. Wu tɛ gɛ̀ bee muh wu ŋgoo yi Jiso le.
Wu gɛɛŋ wu yɛŋ Balɛt le wu lɛgɛ lɛ wu nyâ gvunɛ chi Jiso wu le wu gɛ̂ɛŋ wu jîiyɛ. Noo, Balɛt mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ bo gɛ̂ɛŋ bo nyâ wu le.
Yosɛf fi gvunɛ chiyu wu kujɛ a nju yì yuude le,
wu mo wu gɛɛŋ wu giŋsɛ a jɛŋ ye yì baaŋ yifiɛŋ le. Wu gɛ̀ cho jɛŋ yiyu yi kimbaaŋ le, wu mo wu biŋsɛ kibwee ki tɛdɛ wu baŋɛ jwe wu jɛŋ yɛɛ yu, wu mo wu ja.
Mɛɛle Madaleŋ bɛ Mɛɛle wumu wɛɛ gɛ̀ bee fo, bo shii mbebe jɛŋ yiyu le, kimbe kege le.
Bo tu bo chiɛɛne jɛŋ yi Jiso
Akfuuŋ bu ayuu, juu chi bo to bo seese mwɛɛ mu yuuŋ chiboo gɛ̀ fe wa, bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ Bafalashii gɛɛŋ bo yɛŋ Balɛt le,
bo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Muh wù baaŋ, bee be kwaji fiɛɛ fì muh wu chimbiaŋ wɛɛ gɛ̀ jɛme sege wu gɛ̀ baaŋ yu. Wu gɛ̀ bee wu jɛmɛ lɛ, le to bu aju atade wu kaasɛ wu bu yi kwe le.

No fi le noo, wo du bamii gɛɛŋ bo chîɛɛne jɛŋ yɛɛ gɛɛŋ bu aju atade, nje bee faane lɛ taŋlo booŋ be ba ŋgoo bo ja bo gɛɛŋ bo choŋ gvunɛ che bo ja bɛ chi bo mo bo sɛŋe bamii le lɛ, ‘Wu le wu bu yi kwe le.’ Nɛ bo ge noo, chimbiaŋ chi mɛɛse chinɛ mo chi fo chi fe lo chi fwe.”
Balɛt du bo le lɛ, “Bɛŋ jô bamii ba nchi bena bo gɛɛŋ, bɛŋ du bo chiɛɛne jɛŋ yɛɛ chuule no taŋlo bo chiɛɛne.”
Noo bo mo bo gɛɛŋ bo baŋɛ jwe wu jɛŋ yiyu chuule bo gɛɛ njiŋɛ yi tɛdɛ chì bo gɛ̀ baŋɛ jwe wu jɛŋ yɛɛ yu, bo mo bo gɛɛ bamii ba nchi bo chîɛɛne.

footnotes.text: Njiŋɛ wunɛ gɛ̀ bee ki bo ge lɛ keefɛ muh fe lo fo gɛ.
